content: Semantics of meta-class DiagnosticJ1939SpnMapping The DiagnosticJ1939SpnMapping has the ability to associate a Diagnos- ticJ1939Spn with a SystemSignal . By this means it is possible to express that a given SystemSignal is taken to transport a J1939 Suspect Parameter Number .
